test_objective: Check that you can create a context source registration without specifying an ID

test_cases.name: 033_01_03 Create Context Source Registration Without A Sprecified ID
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a context source registration without specifying an ID
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations/{context_source_registration_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with data: and
    Query Parameter: context source registration id set to '${registration_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json'
}
